name: Swift 1.5 (UkisAI fine-tune of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next)

lineage.how_derived: tokens linked to pathological overthinking are penalized, accuracy recovered with RL and on-policy distillation

purpose: UkisAI states: a reasoning-efficient derivative with shorter reasoning traces and fewer overthinking errors at near-base accuracy, post-trained for coding and long-horizon agent work (personal agents, terminal use, software engineering).

license.name: Swift Open License 1.0 (free up to USD 1M annual revenue) on top of the Qwen Community License 1.0
license.notes: Swift Open License 1.0 on top of the Qwen Community License 1.0; the repository README was unreadable (29 bytes) on 2026-11-19, so the Swift text was not read. Qwen text read (see the Gyro record): condition 2 applies. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + QSA MoE with n-gram table (qwen4_exp), 512 experts
architecture.why_this_design: Same architecture as the base; the change is training only, to cut overthinking tokens.

variants.format: GGUF IQ1_S 70.1 GB to Q8_0 188.3 GB (IQ4_XS 97.7 GB, Q4_K_M 119.6 GB)
variants.notes: card recommends IQ4_XS for 128 GB unified memory
IQ2_XS 68 GB in toolchain/models.toml (fetched for comparison only, never ran in Tona)

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from the file size (68.2 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 60 GB; about 14% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from the file size (68.2 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 64 GB; about 20% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (68.2 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM = 144 GB; about 43% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (68.2 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (68.2 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 22 GB)

engine_support.notes: same tensors as the base; Tona's Coder backend would load a 512-expert file (flash-next-512-q2_0 in test)

benchmarks.name: AA Coding Index (aggregator mirror), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next base
benchmarks.harness: aggregator mirror of the Artificial Analysis Coding Index, read 2026-11-19; no per-row dates; upstream AA pages not reachable

strengths: Thinking tokens cut by 31 to 57 % on reasoning benchmarks at near-equal accuracy (vendor)
Slightly better LiveCodeBench and Terminal-Bench than the base (vendor)
weaknesses: On Terminal-Bench it produced more total output tokens (45,428 vs 40,591)
At medium and low reasoning effort accuracy drops about 2.5 points
IFBench down 3 points; no SWE-bench; no coder prune exists for it
soft.behavior: Benchmarks at effort xhigh, T 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20.
soft.maturity: Small vendor; license is custom; all numbers self-reported.

tona_fit.reason: Zero kernel work in principle (same tensors) and shorter thinking saves wall time, but 512 experts cache poorly in 16 GB VRAM and there is no coder prune; revisit if someone prunes it with code calibration.
